title: An attacker can send a notify request that causes the root zone to be added as a secondary domain to be added to the…
description: A vulnerability in the BIND DNS server allows an attacker to send a crafted notify request that causes the root zone to be added as a secondary domain. This triggers the backend to update its configuration to an invalid state, preventing it from running after a restart and requiring manual intervention to fix. Although a general fix was applied in SA-2026-05, it did not properly address the root zone case, which has now been corrected.
